correctness.rationale: For B_q=C7[Kq], independent sets choose at most one color from any independent layer set in C7. The augmented fiber zero-chains split integrally into a distinguished base color plus the rank-(q−1) augmentation kernel, giving link-indexed chain summands. K=Ind(C7) collapses via seven free triangle edges to a 7-cycle; the only contributing nonempty links are seven distance-two pairs (S0) and seven maximal triples (void link). Hence H~1=Z and H~2=Z^{7q(q−1)^2}, all other groups zero and no torsion. The D7 action preserves the chosen color decomposition; signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces on C0,C1,C2 for a reflection are (q,−2q,−q²), while nontrivial rotations fix no faces. H1 is reflection-sign. Therefore H2 has character (7q(q−1)^2,0,−(q−1)(q−2)) on identity, nonidentity rotation, reflection, giving multiplicities a=(q−1)(q²−2q+2)/2, b=(q−1)(q²−2)/2, c=q(q−1)². Independently enumerated faces and mod2 boundaries and reflected Lefschetz signs for q=2,3,4; universal claim rests on the equivariant integral chain splitting.
